errors.text_span: 该柱状图展示了句子主客体距离与模型F1值之间的关联
errors.evidence: The x-axis label is '要素距离' (element distance), not '句子主客体距离' (subject-object distance in sentences).
The description does not explicitly state the purpose of the chart as comparing '本文方法' and '基线模型' across different element distances.
The description does not mention the legend position (right upper corner) or the specific shading styles used to distinguish the series.
The description does not explicitly state that the lighter shade represents '本文方法' and the darker shade represents '基线模型'.
The description omits the finding that the proposed method performs significantly better in the '远' (far) category, which is a key insight.
